STAKING.STAKINGTITLE: Chikwama chemari chiri kutengeswa pari zvino
STAKING.NOTENABLEDINSTR: Kuti uise stake unofanira kugonesa staking setting staking=1 mufaira rako remetrix.conf.
STAKING.NOTSTAKINGINSTR: Unogona kutanga kuisa mari muchitoro nekuvhura chikwama chako kuti uise mari muchitoro

MASTERNODES.NOMNOUTPUTS: Hapana zvakabuda paMasternode. Kuti ushandise Masternode yemuno tumira mari inosvika mamiriyoni 2, 5, 25, 50 kana 100 kukero yako yeMasternode womirira zvisimbiso gumi neshanu.

SIGNMESSAGE.SIGN_DESCRIPTION: Unogona kusaina mameseji nekero dzako kuratidza kuti ndiwe muridzi wadzo. Chenjerera kuti usasaina chero chinhu chisina kujeka, sezvo kurwiswa kwephishing kunogona kuedza kukunyengera kuti usainire humbowo hwako kwavari. Saina chete zvirevo zvakakwana zvaunobvumirana nazvo.
SIGNMESSAGE.VERIFY_DESCRIPTION: Isa kero yekusaina, meseji (ita shuwa kuti wakopa mitsetse yakatyoka, nzvimbo, ma tab, nezvimwewo) uye siginecha iri pazasi kuti usimbise meseji yacho. Chenjerera kuti usaverenge zvakawanda zviri mu siginecha kupfuura zviri mumeseji yakasaina pachayo, kuti usanyengerwa nekurwisa kwemunhu ari pakati.

DEBUG.CONSOLEINFO: Tinokugamuchirai kuMetrix Core RPC console. Nyora rubatsiro kuti uwane ruzivo rwemirairo iripo.
DEBUG.CONSOLEWARNING: YAMBIRO: Vanyengeri vanga vachishanda, vachiudza vashandisi kuti vanyore mirairo pano, vachiba zviri muwallet yavo. Usashandise iyi console usina kunzwisisa zvizere mhedzisiro yemurairo.

REPAIR.INFOEXTERNAL: Mirairo iyi yekugadzirisa haigone kuitwa kana Metrix Core yaitwa kunze
REPAIR.INFO: Mabhatani ari pazasi achatangazve Metrix Core nesarudzo dzemirairo yekugadzirisa chikwama, kugadzirisa matambudziko ane mafaira e blockchain akaora kana kutengeserana kusiripo/kwekare.
REPAIR.SALVAGEINFO: -salvagewallet: Kuedza kudzosa makiyi akavanzika kubva muwallet yakaora.dat.
REPAIR.RESCANINFO: -scan: Scan zvakare blockchain kuti uone kana paine kutengeserana kwewallet kusina kushanda.
REPAIR.RECOVER1INFO: -zapwallettxes=1: Dzorera kutengeserana kubva ku blockchain (chengeta meta-data, semuenzaniso muridzi weakaunti)
REPAIR.RECOVER2INFO: -zapwallettxes=2: Dzorera kutengeserana kubva ku blockchain (donhedza meta-data)
REPAIR.UPGRADEWALLETINFO: -upgradewallet: Simudzira wallet kuita fomati yazvino pakatanga. (Cherechedza: iyi HAISI update yewallet pachayo!)
REPAIR.REBUILDINDEXINFO: -reindex: Kuvaka patsva indekisi ye blockchain kubva pamafaira e blk000 aripo iye zvino.
REPAIR.BOOTSTRAPINFO: Kudhawunirodha mafaira eMetrix blockchain kubva kumetrixcoin.com uye kutangazve kuisa kwako. Zvichienderana ne network yako, izvi zvinogona kutora maminetsi gumi kusvika maawa maviri.
REPAIR.SYNCFROMSTARTINFO: Bvisa mafaira e blockchain emunharaunda yako uye batanidzazve kubva pa genesis block.
REPAIR.RESTARTCOREINFO: Tangazve Metrix Core kana yatove kushanda kana kutanga Metrix Core kana isiri kushanda.
REPAIR.REINSTALLCOREINFO: Bvisa Metrix Core yako yemuno woiisazve kubva kumaseva eMetrix.

PROMPT.CLIENTUPDATEINFO: Pane imwe update iripo yeMetrix Core. Ungada kuiisa izvozvi here?
PROMPT.WALLETUPDATEINFO: Pane imwe update yeAltitude iripo. Ungada kuidhawunirodha izvozvi here?
PROMPT.CLIENTSTOPPEDINFO: Kubatana kwakarasika kuMetrix Core. Unogona kumisa chikwama kana kutanga Metrix Core yemukati.
PROMPT.ENCRYPTEDCONTENT: Chero ma backup awakamboita efaira rako rewallet anofanira kutsiviwa nefaira rewallet rakagadzirwa, rakavharirwa. Nekuda kwekuchengetedza, ma backup ekare efaira rewallet risina kuvharirwa haazoshandi kana wangotanga kushandisa wallet itsva, yakavharirwa.
PROMPT.CLIENTCLOSEDUNEXPECTEDINFO: Paiva nedambudziko neMetrix Core rakaita kuti igumiswe. Zvinokurudzirwa kuti utarise faira rako re debug.log kuti uone kana paine matambudziko.
PROMPT.CLIENTINVALIDCONFIGINFO: Metrix.conf yako ine masternode setup isina kushanda iyo ichaita kuti Metrix Core ibude nekukasika. Ndapota tarisa faira iri.
PROMPT.BOOTSTRAPFAILEDINFO: Pakave nedambudziko pakugadzirisa Metrix Core. Zvinokurudzirwa kuti utarise faira rako reAltitude log kuti uone kana paine matambudziko.
PROMPT.STARTUPFAILEDINFO: Pakave nedambudziko pakutanga Metrix Core. Zvinokurudzirwa kuti utarise faira rako reAltitude log kuti uone kana paine matambudziko.
PROMPT.CLIENTUNKNOWNERRORINFO: Paive nedambudziko pakutaurirana neMetrix Core. Zvinokurudzirwa kuti utarise faira rako re debug.log kuti uone kana paine matambudziko.
PROMPT.UNENROLLGOVERNORCONTENT: Une chokwadi here chekuti unoda kubvisa Gavhuna wako pachigaro? Hauzokwanisi kuvhota pamusoro pekutonga kwecheni.
PROMPT.WALLETUPDATEREADYINFO: Chigadziriso ichi chatorwa. Tangazve Altitude kuti uchiise here?
PROMPT.DAPPCONNECTINFO: Saiti iyi inoda kubatana newallet yako uye kuona kero yako nebhajeti rako.
PROMPT.DAPPSENDINFO: Iyi saiti iri kukumbira kutumira chibvumirano kubva muchikwama chako.
PROMPT.DAPPSIGNINFO: Saiti iyi iri kukumbira kusaina meseji ine kero yako yechikwama.
PROMPT.DAPPNOTREADY: Hazvikwanisike kubatana newebhusaiti parizvino - Metrix Core ichiri kutanga kushanda.
PROMPT.DAPPNOWALLET: Haikwanise kubatana newebhusaiti - hapana kero yewallet iripo.
PROMPT.BOOTSTRAPOFFERINFO: Pane bootstrap yazvino iripo inogona kukurumidza kugadzirisa Metrix Core. Kuramba uchibatanidza zvinhu nenzira yakajairika kunogona kutora mazuva akati wandei kuti ipere, sezvo wallet yako ichida kudhawunirodha uye kusimbisa block yega yega yawarasikirwa nayo.
PROMPT.BOOTSTRAPSPACEINFO: Hapana nzvimbo yakakwana yedhisiki yekudhawunirodha nekuburitsa bootstrap. Inodiwa: {inodiwa}, Inowanikwa: {yemahara}. Bvisa imwe nzvimbo woedza zvakare.

GOVERNANCE.NOTGOVERNORDETAIL: Magavhuna ane basa rekuvhota mabhajeti emwedzi nemwedzi uye shanduko dze blockchain. Unogona kuva Gavhuna nekuvhara chibatiso chakakodzera muchibvumirano cheHurumende.
GOVERNANCE.CONFIRMENROLL: Wava kuda kunyoresa saGavhuna. Izvi zvichatumira chibvumirano chine chibatiso chinodiwa kuchibvumirano chekutonga. Unogona kubvisa kunyoresa chero nguva.
GOVERNANCE.ISGOVERNORDETAIL1: Magavhuna ane basa rekuvhota mabhajeti emwedzi nemwedzi uye shanduko dze blockchain.
GOVERNANCE.ISGOVERNORDETAIL2: Kuti urambe uri Gavhuna uchafanirwa kutora chikamu muvhoti imwe chete mazuva makumi matatu ega ega.
GOVERNANCE.ISGOVERNORDETAIL3: Kana pasina chekuvhota, unogona kuramba uchinyoresa nemaoko nekutumira ping inoshanda.
GOVERNANCE.NOTFULLYSYNCEDDETAIL: Kunyoresa kwako paGavhuna kuchaonekwa kana blockchain yako yanyatsoenderana.
GOVERNANCE.DGPMIGRATIONINFO: Metrix blockchain iri kuchinjirwa kuDGP. Uchafanirwa kubvisa chibvumirano chekare cheDGP wozonyoresazve mune chitsva. Kana uine Gavhuna wekare, uchaona bhatani rekuregedza papeji rino chete.
GOVERNANCE.DGPMIGRATIONINFO2: Kunyoresa DGP itsva kuchakwanisika kana kambani yatanga kushanda pa "onchain". Discord yedu ichange iine ruzivo rwechizvino-zvino nezveizvi.
GOVERNANCE.UNENROLLV1INFO1: Bhatani riri pazasi richabvisa vhezheni yako yekare yeGovernor uye richadzosera chibatiso chako.
GOVERNANCE.UNENROLLV1INFO2: Kana kuburitswa kwako kwapera, sarudzo iyi ichanyangarika.

LIST.EMPTYDETAIL: Altitude inotarisa otomatiki block explorer kuti ione kana paine MRC20 neMRC721 tokens dzakatumirwa kukero dzako, uye yobva yaongorora zvese zviri mhenyu zvichienderana ne node yako. Unogona zvakare kuwedzera token nemaoko kana uchiziva kero yayo yechibvumirano.
